g.data-latex: \mathrm{popc} : \{0, 1\}^k \rightarrow \mathbb{N} \\ \mathrm{popc} ~ v = \sum_{i=0}^{k} v_i \\ \mathrm{prefixsum} : \{0, 1\}^k \rightarrow \mathbb{N}^k \\ w = \mathrm{prefixsum} ~ v = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 0 & i = 0 \\ \mathrm{popc} [v_0, v_1, \cdots, v_{i-1} ] & i > 0 \end{array} \right. \\ ~ \\ \mathbf{Theorem}. k > 0 \rightarrow w_{k-1} = \mathrm{popc}~v \vee w_{k-1} = \mathrm{popc} ~v - 1
